title: Circular On The Implementation of Prakas on Capital Buffer in Deposit-taking Banks and Financial Institutions
text:
KINGDOM OF CAMBODIA
NATION RELIGION KING
NATIONAL BANK OF CAMBODIA
Number. . '2.P..J..,. . .015 ..... 00. .1 ... .. .C.. .. L... ..
Unofficial Translation
Phnom Penh, November 24, 2025
Circular
On
The Implementation of Prakas on Capital Buffer
in Deposit-taking Banks and Financial Institutions
With reference to the Royal Kram NS/RKM/1199/13 of November 18, 1999 promulgation on the
Law on Banking and Financial Institutions, Prakas N° B37.025.536 Prokor dated November 19, 2025
on Capital Buffer in Deposit-taking Banks and Financial Institutions, and given the robustness of
the current banking system and the credit growth in Cambodia are appropriate within the
Cambodian economic context, the National Bank of Cambodia has determined the countercyclical
capital buffer at a level of 0% until a new announcement is released.
This circular shall take effect from the signing date.
The Governor
Signed and Sealed: Chea Serey
